meta.name: Triage AWS security posture changes with Claude, Slack, email, and WhatsApp alerts

parameters.content:
## AI AWS Security & Policy Agent

### How it works

This workflow polls or manually checks AWS security findings (simulated in-workflow, no external API calls), compares them with the previous baseline, and stops early when nothing has changed. When changes are detected, it enriches findings with simulated asset inventory data, uses an AI agent to assess security impact, then routes items by severity for review or approval. Approved or reviewable cases update a simulated security posture record, log a simulated audit trail, notify stakeholders via Slack, Email and WhatsApp, and persist the new baseline for the next comparison cycle. Wait nodes are placed between key stages to pace the run.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger interval for the desired security polling cadence.
- Set the AWS account ID, AWS region, and Anthropic model in the configuration node.
- Configure Anthropic/Claude credentials for the Security Impact Analysis Agent and review the prompt/model settings.
- Connect Slack credentials and set the correct channels for security review, rejection, SecOps, and compliance notifications.
- Configure email sending credentials and recipients for the security summary email.
- Connect WhatsApp Business Cloud credentials and set the phone number ID / recipient number for WhatsApp alerts.
- Configure the wait/sign-off mechanism so the security lead can approve or reject high-risk cases, and adjust the pacing wait nodes as needed.

### Customization

Adjust the change-detection logic, AI risk-analysis prompt, severity routing rules, approval requirements, notification recipients (Slack/Email/WhatsApp), wait durations, and baseline persistence method to match your security operations process. Replace the simulated data code nodes with real API/HTTP calls if you want to connect to live systems again.

## Start and configure run

Scheduled and manual entry points start the workflow, then shared AWS account, region, and notification configuration values are prepared for the rest of the run. A short wait follows before the findings check begins.

## Fetch and detect changes

Simulates the latest security findings (no external API call) and compares them against the previous snapshot, then branches based on whether any relevant findings or policy data changed.

## Enrich finding context

Simulates AWS account asset inventory data (no external API call) and merges it with the changed security findings so downstream analysis has resource context.

## Analyze and route risk

Waits briefly, then uses the Claude-backed AI security analysis agent to assess impact, parses the analysis output, and routes the case by risk severity.

## High-risk approval gate

Handles the high-severity path by waiting for security lead sign-off and checking whether the case was approved or rejected.

## Rejected case notification

Marks rejected high-risk cases with a rejected status and sends a Slack notification about the sign-off rejection.

## Review notification path

Sends non-blocking risk cases to Slack for review before they continue into the posture update path.

## Update and audit records

Simulates updating the security posture record and writes a simulated compliance audit trail entry for the processed case (no external API calls), then waits briefly before notifications go out.

## Notify stakeholder teams

Fans out completion notifications to SecOps (Slack), compliance (Slack), email recipients, and WhatsApp with the final security summary.

## Persist new baseline

Stores the latest findings and policy snapshot as the baseline used by the next scheduled comparison cycle.
